We all know Robin is the quintessential sidekick, that Lex Luthor and the Kingpin are stylish villains and that Harry Potter is a hero and a wizard.

So Voat, what are your favorite obscure characters in fiction and what role do they play in the story?
What are some lesser-know fictional characters that you find remarkable?

I love The Janitor (Jan Itor) on Scrubs - he is a tall and menacing guy but ends up being actually more of a very pathetic villain most of the time, while being extra-weird all around.

The Mayor in Buffy: The Vampire Slayer is a perfect example of a comic book villain on TV - except he was never in a comic book to start with! He is evil incarnate but always goes out of his way to come off as a nice and pleasant fella to be around, and he really is! Charming and confident in his creepy yet somehow endearing demeanor... Lindsey from Angel (BtVS's sister series) is also a very unique villain, one of the best examples of character development I've ever seen.

Christopher Foyle. If you've never watched Foyle's War you're in for a treat as all 9 "series" are on Netflix now. It's a very well done BBC show. What's run of the mill is that it's a detective show, what isn't so run of the mill is that it's set in WW2 England with lots of chaos and some gold old fashioned espionage thrown in.

A lot of minor characters from Marvel Comics. Vulcan: Can control all energy, hasn't really been explored to his full power (and the author has said he can be more poweful). Most likely because... well, what can win against something that can control all energy? I guess it could be a story arc with other incredibly powerful marvel characters.

Speaking of which, Skaar. Hulk's son. Another incredibly powerful character whose powers haven't been fully explored, last I checked. So, you guys know his dad. The hulk. You might know his mother (I forget her name. Cassandra?) She has a power to use the earth's tectonic powers in many ways, with which she could pretty much match the hulk, even in his more intelligent state. Skaar has both (or had at least, the gamma ones might have been taken). His hulk ones seemingly aren't as powerful, but he keeps a higher level of intelligence than the hulk usually does, and he has at least some of the mother's powers in his hulk form to help out.

There's a bunch of other marvel characters. I really just like those whose potential hasn't been really explored.
Dolorous Edd from the a song of ice and fire books.

I really liked Brawne Lamia and Martin Silenus from Hyperion. Really all those characters. And even though a lot of people hated the sequels, I loved them and really liked Endymion from his story arc.

Also, in Saga (the comic series) I really like Lying Cat.
Hokuto. The game she was in, Street Fighter EX, was a non-canon spinoff with a vauge story that you'd have to read the manual to know about, but she's really fun to play as.
